name: BMW
description: BMW is a German vehicle manufacturer with a long history of passenger cars, performance models and electrified vehicles. On ECU Docs, BMW pages are intended to connect manufacturer context with the technical resources that already exist for supported vehicles and control units.
history: BMW traces its corporate history to the early twentieth century and has developed into a global manufacturer spanning premium passenger cars, performance vehicles and motorcycles. For technical research, model generation, engine family and control-unit context are more useful than broad marketing descriptions, so this page focuses on information that can be connected to ECU Docs resources.
ecu_information: BMW vehicles use multiple electronic control modules across powertrain, chassis, body and infotainment systems. ECU Docs should only surface controller-specific claims when they are backed by documentation already available in the project, such as manuals, pinouts or model-level technical records.
